firm_data.firm_description: Gassman Baiamonte Gruner, P.C., has established itself as Greater New York's premier matrimonial and family law firm and is one of the most respected and sought-after matrimonial law firms serving Long Island's (Nassau County and Suffolk County) and the greater New York Metropolitan area. Our team of experienced and skilled attorneys have devoted themselves exclusively to the highly specialized fields of matrimonial and family law.
notable_facts: Focuses exclusively on matrimonial and family law

email.subject: AI for Gassman Baiamonte Gruner, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Stephen,

Gassman Baiamonte Gruner has built something rare: a 55-year track record as Greater New York's premier matrimonial firm while staying exclusively focused on family law. That discipline is exactly why we wanted to reach out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York region to meet firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Garden City office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping matrimonial practices compete while managing equitable distribution and custody matters with greater speed.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
